name: II cabinet
install: set -euo pipefail; script=$(find "$PWD" "$PWD/.." "$PWD/../.." /agent /workspace -path '*/.git' -prune -o -path '*/.cursor/install.sh' -type f -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$script" ]; then echo "install.sh not found under $PWD" >&2; exit 1; fi; bash "$script"
start: set -euo pipefail; script=$(find "$PWD" "$PWD/.." "$PWD/../.." /agent /workspace -path '*/.git' -prune -o -path '*/.cursor/start.sh' -type f -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$script" ]; then echo "start.sh not found under $PWD" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec bash "$script"
